pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Cabin on your own computer in one line, confirm yourself as the owner and open the app.

pages.title: Homes and people
pages.summary: Add each home with its owner and commission, then give managers and cleaners their own access.

pages.title: Channel calendars
pages.summary: Connect each home's Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com calendar links, publish Cabin's own links back, read the calendar grid and take requests without double bookings.

pages.title: Direct bookings
pages.summary: Publish each home's booking page, set stay rules and taxes, collect Stripe test payments, and retain signed agreements, ID checks and damage holds.

pages.title: Turnovers
pages.summary: Assign a cleaner and a checklist to a departing booking; the cleaner ticks every item and adds a photo.

pages.title: Owner statements
pages.summary: Enter a month's income and costs for a home, check the management fee and owner net, approve and download the CSV.

pages.title: Agent access
pages.summary: Give the agent you already use a token to prepare calendar reviews, turnovers and statements for a person to approve.

pages.title: Move in your homes
pages.summary: Preview a property register CSV, approve the exact plan, follow the journal and undo while records are untouched.

pages.title: Back up, restore and erase
pages.summary: Export the whole installation to one archive, restore it into a fresh copy, and erase a home for good.

pages.title: Command reference
pages.summary: Every command the app and the agent door accept, with its input and who may run it.
